description: Japanese <-> English clipboard translator that runs fully locally (llama.cpp + PLaMo 3 Translate). Select text, press a hotkey, paste.
notes: The translation model (over 1 GB) and llama.cpp are downloaded once while installing.
Start 'Clipboard Translator' from the Start menu; it lives in the system tray. Hotkey: Ctrl+Alt+E.
Built with PLaMo. The model has its own license: https://plamo.preferredai.jp/info/plamo-community-license-ja
pre_uninstall: # Ask a running copy to quit (it also stops its llama-server) so Scoop can delete the files.
Get-Process -Name ClipboardTranslator, llama-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path.StartsWith($dir, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Stop-Process -Force
post_install: # Download the model and llama.cpp into the persisted folders (skipped when they are already there).
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { error 'setup.ps1 failed. Run it again from the app folder, or start the app and accept its offer to download the model.' }
